profile_subheading: Update your own name and phone number.

profile_noRecordBody: Your account is not linked to any resident record in this complex yet. Contact the management to be registered to your unit.
profile_notifications_subheading: Choose which emails you want to receive. Some notification kinds cannot be turned off.

profile_notifications_kind_newPost_descr: Email when a new announcement or activity is posted on the board.
